title: Ramsey properties of trees and $C$-relations via the partite construction
summary: Finite convexly ordered binary branching $C$-relations have been viewed as a notable exception to the broad applicability of the partite construction in structural Ramsey theory. The absence of a proof of their Ramsey property by the partite construction was noted by Bodirsky in his 2015 survey and pointed out again by Hubička and Konečný in their 2026 survey.
